The '''Imperial Skirmishes''' was the last major campaign fought by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Launched in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the joint campaign by the Remnant and the [[replacement warlord]]s of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] was an unmitigated Imperial defeat, seeing a massive reduction in the size of [[Imperial Space]] and reducing the Remnant to a mere eight [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] sectors. The Imperial Remnant would seek peace with the New Republic two years later.

==Prelude==
In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], after four relatively peaceful years, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] systems near the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] began to suggest the cessation of hostilities. The New Republic [[New Republic amnesty bill|lifted its ban]] on former Imperial officials holding elective office. The move was intended as a peace offering, but the Moffs saw it as the prelude to an invasion.<ref name="TEA" />

Fearing invasion, the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]] secretly contacted [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]], who'd returned to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and unified the "[[replacement warlord]]s", ambitious beings who had taken control of what little infrastructure remained after Pellaeon abandoned the Deep Core and replaced the officers Daala had killed at [[Tsoss Beacon/Legends|Tsoss Beacon]]. Daala was convinced to fight, and the Moffs ordered Pellaeon to begin another campaign against the New Republic.

The New Republic was recovering from the [[Almanian Uprising]] and appeared divided. Furthermore, since the [[Orinda campaign]] the Imperial Remnant had received an injection of forces from the [[Black Fleet]] fleeing the Yevetha, among them the [[Sorannan-class Star Destroyer|prototype Star Destroyer]] ''EX-F'', renamed the [[Rakehell (Sorannan-class)|''Rakehell'']]. Pellaeon - now a [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] - thought the plan mad, but hoped to that he could win a few quick victories to satisfy the Moffs before offering peace terms to the New Republic.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref><ref name="TEA" />

==The campaign==
What followed was an unmitigated disaster for the Imperial Remnant. Daala struck out of the Deep Core but her fleet was shattered by [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] at the [[Battle of Columus (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Columus]]. She was forced into a blind hyperspace jump and thought dead until she re-emerged in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. Pellaeon's attack began well: he [[Battle of Adumar (17 ABY)|took Adumar]] and won surprise attacks on [[First battle of Taris|Taris]] and [[Battle of Champala]] on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], pushing all the way to the edge of the Core Worlds, but with Daala defeated, Ackbar and Bel Iblis were able to bring the full weight of the New Republic Defense Force to bear.<ref name="TEGtW" /><ref name="TEA" />

The [[Second Battle of Champala]] was an Imperial rout. Pellaeon was chased back to [[Imperial Space]], which was rapidly reduced after defeats at [[Ketaris/Legends|Ketaris]] and [[Tangrene]]. Hoping to salvage a victory, Pellaeon deployed his surviving dreadnoughts [[Dominion (Star Dreadnought)|''Dominion'']] and ''[[Megador]]'', as well as the [[Rakehell (Sorannan-class)|''Rakehell'']], at [[Anx Minor/Legends|Anx Minor]]. The [[Battle of Anx Minor]] was a disaster, with the ''Megador'' and the ''Dominion'' suffering severe damage in the detonation of the ''Rakehell's'' [[antimatter]] reservoir. Pellaeon ordered an immediate retreat to [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].TEGtW<ref name="TEA" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|It's time to send an emissary to the New Republic. To discuss the terms of our surrender.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ardiff]]|<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>}}
New Republic forces under [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] and [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] reduced the Imperial Remnant to a mere eight [[Sector/Legends|sectors]], with [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]] and [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] the only planets of note. This time the New Republic decided to not leave the initiative to the Imperial Remnant like the previous years. In [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], the Republic fleet continued to keep the pressure on the Remnant, more particularly during the [[Corellian Crisis]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Imperial Remnant would remain bottled up in its last eight sectors for another two years until its hopeless position forced Pellaeon to sue for peace. Despite the [[Caamas Document Crisis]] nearly ruining negotiations, this eventually resulted in the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] and the end of the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="TEA" />
